candidates.location_hint: the paragraph that displays when the request fails
candidates.why: Check whether this paragraph needs a live region attribute or persistent container so failures are announced when the loading indicator disappears.

candidates.location_hint: the list that renders after a successful retry
candidates.why: Check whether this list needs an announcement mechanism to signal data arrival, since the previous loading indicator unmounts at the same time.

candidates.location_hint: the individual transaction rows in the results list
candidates.why: Check whether these rows need labels or table semantics so assistive technology can correctly associate each value with its meaning.

candidates.location_hint: the dynamic container that swaps between loading, error, and ready states
candidates.why: Check whether keeping the live region mounted across all states would prevent announcements from being cut off during status transitions.
